name: echo
title: Echo
summary: Each keyword you say lands huge behind your head the instant you say it, in big warm off-white type; the next one slams in and replaces it.
keyMoment: the first keyword slams in behind your head on the frame you start saying it, scaling down from a little too big and settling with weight

variables.label: Keywords to land, in the order you say them, separated by |
Largest type size in px (shrinks to fit the width)
How much of the last line shows above your head, 0.2 to 1 (the rest hides behind it)
How much the type follows your head, 0 to 1
